description: Serialize the current cues stored on a COMP (manage_cue snapshots, keyed 'tdmcp_cues') into a setlist note in the Obsidian vault, so a live-built show can be round-tripped into the vault library as a git-diffable setlist. The note frontmatter `tracks` array matches what import_setlist expects — each cue becomes a track with its title and optional bpm, ready for a recipe id to be added by hand. Re-import the note later with import_setlist to rebuild the visuals. Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

include_tempo.description: Capture the project's global tempo into the note.

note.description: Setlist note name to write (e.g. 'Friday Set').

target.description: COMP whose stored cues/scenes to export as a setlist.

name: export_setlist_to_vault
title: Export setlist to vault
